meta.title: Visual Browser
meta.description: One extra door under the right Sidebar's built-in Browser: a live picture of the Chrome the Agent drives. A permanent tab strip reorders by drag (lifted, frosted glass, other tabs move out of the way) and a right-click menu refreshes, copies the link, opens it in your own default browser, references a page in the chat, closes one tab or all of them; focusing the address box lists the browsing history (one-line "title - domain" rows, prefix filtering, arrow keys fill the box, each row can be deleted). The toolbar's Follow switch hands the whole panel to the Agent — a clear-centred, pale orange-red mask takes every click and the picture jumps to whichever tab the Agent touches; Esc or the mask's own button gives the panel back. Clicks, drags, wheel and the keyboard go straight to the page, and the cursor is drawn at the picture's scale. The bottom dock is the active page's own console: its console output streams in, and you can run your own scripts there and see the returned value or error. Acting tools answer with the numbered view and a picture of the result together. While the Agent works, a tinted lock veil covers the picture and its clicks, scrolls and drags are drawn as ripple, arrows and a grabbing hand.
